In today’s episode of The Daily Brief, we take a deep dive into one key story and cover another story shaping Indian and global markets:
1. Indian Steel: Too Much Protection?
India is the world’s second-largest steel producer, but its steel industry is protected by tariffs, export duties and quality-control rules. We look at whether these policies are helping Indian steelmakers—or making steel more expensive and hurting downstream industries.
